candidates.sentence: With the 2nd Amendment under continuous attack, I believe we must stand up and protect the God-given right for law-abiding Americans to own, keep, and maintain firearms.
However, our broken immigration system has led to a country where millions are here illegally while those looking to come into the country legally must wait for years.

For our borders to remain secure, we must end catch and release, cease exploitation of parole authority, reinstitute the Remain in Mexico program, expand expedited removal, and restart border protection enhancements, including the wall, which Border Patrol said would stop 95% of entries.

He is focused on promoting economic prosperity and job creation in Ohio, as well as throughout the country, and believes we must balance the budget, reduce the national debt, and work toward commonsense government reforms.
